description: This file is an HTML webpage that sets up the CodeMirror editor with the LESS language mode. It contains HTML, CSS, and JavaScript code for displaying and initializing a syntax-highlighted editor for LESS code, including references to external scripts and stylesheets, and instructional content about the LESS mode.

methods.name: CodeMirror.fromTextArea
methods.description: Initializes a CodeMirror editor instance from a textarea element, configuring line numbers, bracket matching, and setting the mode to LESS.
